positive_control.pos_preverification_rule: POS controls are pre-verified on BOTH crosswalk directions (forward BPS Lampiran 5 AND reverse Lampiran 10) BEFORE enrollment as a gold control — not merely digest-selected by lowest sha256. Pre-verification is executed by the CONDUCTOR at REVEAL time (post-lot-close), per the Lot 3 gate report's control protocol note (§4): 'pre-verify on BOTH directions -> 2/2 clean controls (vs 0/2 in Lot 2)' — this is now the standing protocol for every lot from v3 forward.
positive_control.selection_rule: among eligible codes EXCLUDING both the 8 Lot-1 AND the 8 Lot-2 revealed positive controls (16 burned total), the 8 with the lowest sha256(code + "|" + manifest_digest + "|v3") hex digest, sorted ascending — deterministic, never conductor-picked
